'''Mugaari Space''' was a region shared between the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin]] and [[Bruanii sector/Legends|Bruanii]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]].

==History==
A pirate faction of the [[Mugaari]], known as the [[Mugaari pirates]], fought as a resistance movement in Mugaari Space against the newly established [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but more especially in the [[Aftermath of Hoth|aftermath]] of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], aiding [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces leaving from the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]].
